description: Whether an instant is in 14 CFR 61.57(b)'s night-passenger period at a point: from 1 hour after sunset to 1 hour before sunrise (the sun's centre 0.833 degrees down, NOAA's solar calculation), its own window rather than 14 CFR 1.1's night, so a high-latitude summer night with no 1.1 night still has it.
